messages:
sarah_peopleops: Heads up — Emily (CA-based) was onsite in NYC for client work 3/10–3/30 (21 days). Payroll shows NY withholding on the 3/15 and 3/30 payruns and the per-diem reimbursement was taxed. Can payroll confirm what flags were applied and whether we need to reverse YTD state tax postings? cc @juan_payroll @priya_tax
juan_payroll: Looking now. I see payrun 2024-03-30 has code NY_WITHHOLD and the expense line PERDIEM marked TAXABLE. Usually per-diem under an accountable plan is non-taxable. Do we have receipts and travel logs? Also needs SUI check (employee payroll setup is CA).
priya_tax: Quick note — NY nonresident withholding can apply based on days worked physically in NY. There's no CA↔NY reciprocity, so Washington rules don't apply. If per-diem was a true accountable reimbursement (receipts + business reason) we can reclassify retroactively and adjust NY taxable wages. If material, we may need a W-2C. Share receipts and travel cert.
emily: I uploaded per-diem receipts to Concur yesterday (expense #4567) and added the travel calendar entry. Travel dates in calendar: 2024-03-10 to 2024-03-30. Happy to DM any missing docs.
juan_payroll: Got the Concur upload, thanks. I can open an off-cycle reversal to remove TAXABLE flag and recalc NY withholding for 3/15 and 3/30. Before I run it need tax sign-off to proceed with reclassification + YTD adjustments. Also confirm: do we keep SUI under CA (yes) and do not change employer state for UI.
priya_tax: Sign-off to proceed with reclassification based on receipts. Process: 1) reclass per-diem as non-taxable accountable reimbursement, 2) recalc YTD NY taxable wages and withholding, 3) if overwithheld amount is below our refund threshold we post refund in next payroll, otherwise prepare W-2C. Also document travel substantiation in the tax file. SUI remains CA-based.
payroll_bot: Off-cycle job queued: OC-202403-789. Reason: reclassify per-diem -> non-taxable (accountable plan); adjust NY state withholding for 2024-03 payruns. ETA: 2 pay cycles.
sarah_peopleops: Thanks — Juan please add a one-line note in Payroll Ops (doc link) with the OC job id and tag Emily. Priya, if you want us to notify NYDOF or keep for internal records only, say so. Emily expect either a small net pay bump next cycle or a manual refund depending on the amount.
emily: Thanks all — I can forward any additional receipts or sign a travel attestation form if needed. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
juan_payroll: Will update here when OC posts and when the refund/adjustment shows up. :thumbsup:
